title: Dark’s Redeemable Code
description: Dark’s Redeemable Code is a Minecraft plugin that allows admins to create and manage redeemable codes, giving players rewards through a simple GUI while tracking redemptions
body:
**Dark’s Redeemable Code** is a versatile Minecraft plugin for server owners and admins to create redeemable codes that give players custom rewards. Compatible with Minecraft 1.20.4 and tested on 1.21, it ensures smooth operation on recent server versions.

Admins can manage codes through an intuitive GUI inventory, setting rewards, usage limits, and expiration times. Players redeem codes to receive pre-set rewards, while the plugin tracks usage and automatically cleans up expired codes.

**Key Features:**

- Create and manage redeemable codes easily.
  
- Inventory GUI for admins to assign rewards.
  
- Track code usage and redeemed players.
  
- Automatic cleanup of expired codes.
  
- Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.20.4 and 1.21.


**Commands & Permissions:**


```
/redeem <code> – Redeem a code. No permission required.

/redeem create <codeName> <uses> <timeInSeconds> – Create/edit a code and set rewards via GUI. Permission: darks.redeem.admin

/redeem list – List active codes. Permission: darks.redeem.admin

/redeem delete <codeName> – Delete a code. Permission: darks.redeem.admin

/redeem info <codeName> – View code details, including rewards, expiry, and redeemed players. Permission: darks.redeem.admin

```

Perfect for events, giveaways, or rewarding players with custom items. Simple, configurable, and optimized for modern Minecraft servers.
